description: Analysts may read anything up to CONFIDENTIAL.
Analysts may summarise sources up to CONFIDENTIAL; the report inherits the highest source label.
Analysts may release up to CONFIDENTIAL to approved recipients with matching clearance.
The AI assistant reads only INTERNAL and below.
The AI assistant may only summarise material it was allowed to read.
The AI assistant may deliver INTERNAL material to its single approved recipient.
Interns may compile public material only.
